text: Planning a trip is often as exciting as the journey itself. I spend hours researching destinations, booking flights, and creating a loose itinerary. However, the real magic begins when I arrive. Immersing myself in new cultures always challenges my perspective, whether I’m exploring a bustling market or chatting with a local. Tasting unfamiliar food is a highlight, though I sometimes have no idea what I’m ordering. Language barriers can be frustrating, but a smile and a translation app usually save the day. In the end, these imperfect, spontaneous moments become the memories I treasure most.
